notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
This patch brings several quality-of-life improvements and overall difficulty adjustments.

[b]Update Highlights[/b]

Post-run Statistics
→ After defeating all bosses, you can now view detailed statistics such as expedition time and number of battles.

Character Details
→ When selecting a character, you can now view their background story.

Relic Rarity Display
→ Relics now show their rarity, making strategic choices more meaningful.

Enemy Skill Information
→ Enemy skill information is now displayed during battles, enabling more refined strategies.

Bug Fixes
→ Various bugs have been fixed to provide a more stable gameplay experience.

Overall Difficulty Adjustments
→ The overall difficulty has been lowered so more players can reach the end.
→ AoE skills now have a usage limit.
→ Enemy damage has been slightly reduced.

We look forward to your continued feedback, and we hope you enjoy the game!

The Dev Team

notes.title: Major System Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[h1]Queen Slayer – Major Rebuild Update[/h1]

Hello everyone,  
[b]Queen Slayer[/b] has been completely reworked!

In this update, we've boldly streamlined the previous systems and  
refocused the game around [b]pure combat and roguelike design[/b].  
Now, you can [b]defeat all 8 corrupted queens within 2–3 hours[/b]  
and [b]complete all achievements in a single, tightly focused run[/b].

[h2]Key Changes[/h2]

[b]Complete system overhaul[/b]  
→ Redesigned as a roguelike combat-focused experience, removing excessive complexity

[b]Boss-centered progression[/b]  
→ After 5 waves, you’ll face one of the corrupted queens directly

[b]Short playtime[/b]  
→ Finish the game in 2–3 hours  
→ All achievements can be completed in a single session

[b]Removal of unnecessary systems[/b]  
→ Eliminated farming, fragmented growth systems, and interface clutter

---

This rebuild is not just a balance patch,  
but a [b]fundamental redefinition of the game’s direction and core philosophy[/b].

For those who wanted a short but intense RPG experience,  
your journey begins now.

We’re always listening to your feedback!  
[b]- The Queen Slayer Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[list]  
[*] Improved stat/resistance descriptions and skill explanations in the combat scene.  
[*] Enhanced character selection UI when starting in Path of Hardship mode.  
[*] Fixed a bug where players could receive extra items when restarting a campaign.  
[*] Fixed an issue where certain characters would cause an error when counterattacking.  
[/list]

We will continue focusing on improving the UI and guidance systems, as many players have suggested.  
If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please feel free to share it on the forum — we’ll actively review it.

notes.title: [Update News] New Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The new demo has been updated. In this version, we've adjusted the game to allow you to experiment with 15 unique characters, offering a variety of strategic options. Each character comes with three distinct growth paths, focusing on providing a more refined turn-based combat experience.

Key Updates

15 Playable Characters
Each character has been fine-tuned to offer diverse strategic choices.

Three Growth Paths
Players can choose different growth directions for their characters, shaping their combat style.

Combat System Improvements
The turn-based combat experience has been further refined with improved balance adjustments.
We look forward to your feedback as we continue to enhance the game and make it even better.

Thank you for your support and suggestions!

notes.title: New demo update coming soon with 15 additional characters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103056/fe5a4a469a558b8291fb10a486597a16c8d299ed.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to share some thrilling news with you today! Our team is currently working on the final touches for a brand-new demo version, and we’re almost ready to present it to you. This upcoming demo will feature 15 playable characters that you can experience firsthand!

Key Highlights of the New Demo:
15 Unique Characters:
Each character comes with distinct skills and playstyles, allowing you to explore diverse strategies and combat experiences.

Enhanced Gameplay:
Enjoy improved systems and content, making the gameplay even more engaging and fun.

The release date for the new demo will be announced soon. Stay tuned to this Steam community for updates and details on when you’ll be able to dive in.

Your support and enthusiasm mean the world to us. Thank you for being a part of this journey, and we look forward to seeing you in the upcoming demo! 😊

notes.title: Multilingual Translations Update for Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have updated the demo version with new translations for Korean, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Since translation tools were used in the process, some sentences may not be entirely natural.

If you notice any mistakes or areas that need improvement, we kindly ask for your feedback. Your input will help us refine the translations and provide a better experience for everyone.

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update News!
notes.content:
We've updated the demo version based on valuable user feedback! Here are the key changes in this update:

- Character art has been changed back to the original illustration style.
- Turn order has been made easier to understand.
- A pop-up explaining status effects has been added.
- After battles, characters now recover their Break points.
- Fixed an issue with enemies' status effects.

In our next update, we plan to prepare a multilingual version!
